metaTitle: Custom Neon Bag Clips | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom neon bag clips for high-visibility branding. Perfect for safety teams and events. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Neon bag clips grab attention instantly, making them ideal for safety managers who need employees to secure bags visibly on job sites or for event giveaways where bright colors drive brand recall. Unlike standard bag clips, neon versions stand out in toolboxes, backpacks, or lunch bags. Decorate with your logo using pad printing or screen printing for a durable, vibrant finish that stays visible in low light.
heroAltText: Custom neon bag clips in bright colors with printed logos on a workbench, ideal for branding and safety.
